links.outcome: Appropriateness of LLM glaucoma answers in Traditional Chinese, rated by ophthalmologists on 5-point Likert
links.effect: ChatGPT 4.32 ± 0.65 vs Gemini 4.03 ± 0.66 (P = 0.004); both reasonably appropriate, lower on lifestyle questions; no language-stratified comparison with English.
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved a higher overall appropriateness score (4.32 ± 0.65) than Google Gemini (4.03 ± 0.66), with a statistically significant difference (P = 0.004).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy/appropriateness of ChatGPT and Google Gemini responses to glaucoma questions in Traditional Chinese via ophthalmologist ratings, without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
